author: Laura Mayers
title: Driver says those killed in 'incomprehensible tragedy' are with him always
description: The driver who was behind the wheel of a car that ploughed into a group of people outside a central Victorian pub has detailed his sorrow over the crash.
content:
A man who lost control of his vehicle before veering into two families and killing five people has apologised to those impacted by the crash, calling it an "incomprehensible tragedy".
